25 Years After the Anthrax Attacks, Reauthorize and Modernize PAHPA to Better Protect Americans
news.summary_en: Today, 25 years after the 2001 anthrax attacks, the biological threat landscape is becoming even riskier. It’s time for Congress to reauthorize and modernize the Pandemic and All Hazards Preparedness Act (PAHPA).

news.title: Space Superiority and the Military Tools to Secure It
news.summary_en: Space superiority requires credible military options to protect U.S. forces and counter adversaries’ use of space. Integrating space control capabilities into joint operations can strengthen deterrence and preserve U.S. advantage.

news.title: Capturing National Security Benefits from Offshore Wind
news.summary_en: Turbines, platforms, and subsea cables built for energy can also extend the reach of U.S. maritime surveillance. This report examines the evolving maritime threat environment and assesses the potential for offshore wind infrastructure to bolster national security.
